sections.description:
SUPREME COURT (APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS AND SERVANTS AND TERMS AND
CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 1982
SUPREME COURT
(APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS AND SERVANTS AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE)
RULES, 1982
(Amendment of Sched.)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 20th August, 2009]
S.R.O. 73 (KE)/2009, dated
16-6-2009.---In exercise of powers conferred by Article 208 of the
Constitution, the Supreme Court, with the approval of the President, has
directed that the following amendments be made in the Schedule to the Supreme
Court (Appointment of Officers and Servants and Terms and Conditions of
Service) Rules, 1982, namely.
In the Schedule the existing entry in
Column No. 2 against Sr.No.1 shall be substituted as under:---
"The same pay scale, rank and status
as may, from time to time, be prescribed for the post of Secretary to the
Federal Government in the Federal Secretariat."
